name: @peartube/app
description: PearTube - P2P video streaming app (mobile + desktop)

scripts.android:prebuild: (cat android/local.properties 2>/dev/null > /tmp/local.properties.bak || true) && expo prebuild --platform android --clean && (if [ -s /tmp/local.properties.bak ]; then cat /tmp/local.properties.bak > android/local.properties; else echo "sdk.dir=${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" > android/local.properties; fi)
scripts.android: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run android:prebuild && expo run:android
scripts.ios: pkill -f metro || true; rm -rf /tmp/metro-* || true; npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run ios:prepare && npm run ios:pods && npm run ios:run
scripts.schema: cd ../spec && rm -rf spec/hrpc spec/schema && node schema.cjs
scripts.prepare:mobile-backend: npm run schema && npm run bundle:backend
scripts.desktop:merge: mkdir -p desktop-build && rm -rf desktop-build/_expo desktop-build/assets && rm -f desktop-build/*.html desktop-build/metadata.json desktop-build/favicon.ico && rsync -av .desktop-export/ desktop-build/ && rm -rf .desktop-export
scripts.desktop:worker: mkdir -p desktop-build/build/workers/core desktop-build/build/workers && npx swc workers/desktop/index.ts -o desktop-build/build/workers/core/index.mjs && cp ../backend/src/transcode/hypercore-reader-worker.mjs desktop-build/build/workers/hypercore-reader-worker.mjs
scripts.desktop:build: npm run desktop:export && npm run desktop:merge && npm run desktop:worker && npm run desktop:bundle
scripts.desktop:start: npm run desktop:worker && npm run desktop:bundle && npm run desktop:ebuild && build/dev-macos-arm64/PearTube-dev.app/Contents/MacOS/launcher
scripts.desktop:ecopy: rm -rf build/dev-macos-arm64/PearTube-dev.app/Contents/Resources/app/workers build/dev-macos-arm64/PearTube-dev.app/Contents/Resources/app/node_modules && mkdir -p build/dev-macos-arm64/PearTube-dev.app/Contents/Resources/app/views/app build/dev-macos-arm64/PearTube-dev.app/Contents/Resources/app/workers/core && rsync -a desktop-build/_expo desktop-build/assets desktop-build/index.html desktop-build/favicon.ico build/dev-macos-arm64/PearTube-dev.app/Contents/Resources/app/views/app/ && rsync -a --exclude=index.mjs desktop-build/build/workers/core/ build/dev-macos-arm64/PearTube-dev.app/Contents/Resources/app/workers/core/ && rsync -a desktop-build/build/workers/hypercore-reader-worker.mjs build/dev-macos-arm64/PearTube-dev.app/Contents/Resources/app/workers/
scripts.desktop:dev: npm run schema && npm run desktop:export && npm run desktop:merge && npm run desktop:start
scripts.build:ios: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run ios:prepare && npm run ios:pods && npm run ios:run
scripts.build:ios:device: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run ios:prepare && npm run ios:pods && npm run ios:run:device
scripts.build:android: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run android:prebuild && expo run:android
scripts.build:android:apk: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
scripts.build:android:apk:arm64: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PtargetAbis=arm64-v8a -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a
scripts.build:android:apk:arm64:engine: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run android:prebuild && npm run engine:apply && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PtargetAbis=arm64-v8a -PreactNativeArchitectures=arm64-v8a
scripts.build:android:apk:armv7: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PtargetAbis=armeabi-v7a -PreactNativeArchitectures=armeabi-v7a
scripts.build:android:apk:x86_64: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease -PtargetAbis=x86_64 -PreactNativeArchitectures=x86_64
scripts.build:android:aab: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && npm run android:prebuild && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.build:eas:ios: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && eas build --platform ios --profile preview
scripts.build:eas:android: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && eas build --platform android --profile preview
scripts.build:eas:all: npm run prepare:mobile-backend && eas build --platform all --profile preview

author: PearTube
